purpose: Teach: 内戦/銃撃/ラテン語/追い出さ/置き去り/煽っ/潰さ/吸い込ま

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、海外内戦地域の難民医療を医療チーム支援しました
lines.en: Ren, I wanted to tell you — our medical team has been supporting refugee care in conflict zones overseas.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Steady eye contact. The clarity of someone who has seen difficult things and speaks about them plainly. Slight pause before the main clause, as if choosing words with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 銃撃の被害者、貴院、お受け入れになったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has been accepting gunshot victims, then?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not interrogative. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone thinking aloud with respect — working through implications. Soft uptake on the question mark.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ラテン語由来の薬名を医療チーム、覚えております
lines.en: Yes. Our team has been learning the Latin-derived pharmaceutical names — it's essential work.
lines.style: Steady, factual affirmation. No hedging. She delivers this like a simple truth. Slight emphasis on 'essential' — not defensive, just clear about the weight of it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 組織を追い出された医師の再就職、貴院、ご支援なんですね、先生
lines.en: And I gather the hospital also helps doctors who've been pushed out of their previous positions find work again?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative phrasing. He's not challenging — he's recognizing something quietly significant. Pace slightly slower, as if he's still processing what this means.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、自宅で置き去りにされた認知症の方を医療チーム支援します
lines.en: Yes. We also support families like that — people with dementia who've been abandoned at home. The team makes sure they're not forgotten.
lines.style: Even quieter now. The weight of the statement settles in her voice. No performance, just witness. Her breath is steady but there's something underneath — the accumulated weight of these cases.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: SNSで医療不安を煽った投稿、貴院、対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: I see. So when misinformation spreads on social media about medical care, your hospital responds to that too?
lines.style: Slower still. He's moved from observing to understanding. Each word deliberate. The quality of respect deepening — he's beginning to grasp the scope of what she's telling him.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染拡大を潰さねばと医療チーム、努めております
lines.en: Yes. We know infection spread has to be stopped at the source. Our team stays on top of that constantly.
lines.style: Firmness enters here for the first time — not harsh, but resolute. She's moved from explaining to declaring commitment. The pace tightens slightly. This is non-negotiable work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 吸い込まれた異物を内視鏡で除去、貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: And I understand — when someone aspirates a foreign object, your hospital can remove it with an endoscope. That's something you've done.
lines.style: His voice has become almost reverent. Quiet wonder underneath respect. The pacing stretches out — he's saying this half to himself, cataloging what she's shown him. Soft trailing fade on the final words, like he's still taking it in.
